## Commands

`nself ci` runs the plugin binary `nself-ci`. A v1.4 command runs without `NSELF_V15`; a v1.5 command needs `NSELF_V15=1`. Hidden commands are reachable but left out of `--help`.

| Command | Surface | Side effect | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nself ci` | v1.4, v1.5 | remote | Run the nself-ci gate suite and post a GitHub commit status |
| `nself ci artifacts` | v1.5 | read | List, show, fetch and prune stored run artifacts |
| `nself ci artifacts get` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts key` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts list` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts prune` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts release` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts show` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts sign` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts signer` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts tools` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci artifacts verify` | v1.5 | - | - |
| `nself ci build` | v1.4, v1.5 (hidden) | remote | Build a signed release artifact locally (Android only) |
| `nself ci config ignore add` | v1.5 | write | Append a reviewed fingerprint to .gitleaksignore (--reason required) |
| `nself ci config migrate` | v1.5 | write | Migrate .nself/ci.yaml to the current schema (--write applies) |
| `nself ci config show` | v1.5 | read | Show the resolved CI configuration |
| `nself ci doctor` | v1.5 | read | Check the CI environment, nodes and providers (--selftest [--alert] for an unattended host) |
| `nself ci evidence` | v1.5 | read | Show the evidence document of a revision |
| `nself ci evidence verify` | v1.5 | read | Verify the evidence of a revision against the policy |
| `nself ci explain` | v1.5 | read | Explain why a job was or was not planned |
| `nself ci forgejo` | v1.4, v1.5 | read | Show Forgejo server + runner health (ops profile) |
| `nself ci logs` | v1.5 | read | Print the logs of a run attempt (-f follows) |
| `nself ci netproxy` | v1.5 (hidden) | remote | Internal egress proxy used by restricted jobs |
| `nself ci nodes add` | v1.5 | remote | Add and provision a CI node |
| `nself ci nodes discover` | v1.5 | read | Discover nodes on the local network |
| `nself ci nodes drain` | v1.5 | remote | Stop placing new jobs on a node |
| `nself ci nodes enable` | v1.5 | remote | Place jobs on a node again |
| `nself ci nodes forget-project` | v1.5 | destructive | Forget a project's node records on this host (local, audited) |
| `nself ci nodes label` | v1.5 | write | Set or remove node labels (key=value) |
| `nself ci nodes list` | v1.5 | read | List nodes |
| `nself ci nodes pair` | v1.5 | remote | Pair an agent node (foreground enrollment listener) |
| `nself ci nodes pools explain` | v1.5 | read | Explain a project's effective pool set and every excluded runner |
| `nself ci nodes pools list` | v1.5 | read | List runner pools and whether the project may use them |
| `nself ci nodes pools show` | v1.5 | read | Show one runner pool |
| `nself ci nodes projects add` | v1.5 | write | Authorize projects on a node |
| `nself ci nodes projects list` | v1.5 | read | List the projects a node is authorized for |
| `nself ci nodes projects remove` | v1.5 | write | Remove project authorizations from a node |
| `nself ci nodes provision` | v1.4 | remote | Install runner dependencies, user, sudoers, and N runner instances |
| `nself ci nodes remove` | v1.5 | destructive | Remove a node and its registration |
| `nself ci nodes revoke` | v1.5 | destructive | Revoke a node credential |
| `nself ci nodes rotate` | v1.5 | remote | Rotate a node host key, certificate or node key |
| `nself ci nodes secrets grant` | v1.5 | remote | Grant a node access to a secret class |
| `nself ci nodes secrets revoke` | v1.5 | remote | Revoke a node access to a secret class |
| `nself ci nodes set` | v1.5 | remote | Set contention and persistence policy of a node |
| `nself ci nodes show` | v1.5 | read | Show one node |
| `nself ci nodes status` | v1.5 | read | Show readiness, watcher, queue and last results of every node |
| `nself ci nodes sync` | v1.5 | write | Import an inventory/v1 file or command output over the node registry |
| `nself ci nodes test` | v1.5 | remote | Probe a node and report its capabilities |
| `nself ci nodes upgrade` | v1.5 | remote | Upgrade node agents |
| `nself ci nodes verify` | v1.4 | read | Check host(s) against the dependency manifest and report drift |
| `nself ci plan` | v1.5 | read | Plan a run without executing it |
| `nself ci policy pin` | v1.5 | write | Pin or clear the trusted revision |
| `nself ci policy protect` | v1.5 | remote | Show or apply branch protection that requires the nself-ci check |
| `nself ci policy set` | v1.5 | write | Set an operator policy key |
| `nself ci policy show` | v1.5 | read | Show the operator policy |
| `nself ci policy unset` | v1.5 | write | Unset an operator policy key |
| `nself ci policy usage` | v1.5 | read | Show spend and usage against the policy |
| `nself ci providers` | v1.5 | read | Provider command group help |
| `nself ci providers authorize` | v1.5 | remote | Authorize a project for hosted runners |
| `nself ci providers github init` | v1.5 | write | Render the GitHub dispatch workflow |
| `nself ci providers gitlab init` | v1.5 | write | Render the GitLab dispatch pipeline |
| `nself ci providers list` | v1.5 | read | List providers |
| `nself ci providers revoke` | v1.5 | destructive | Revoke a project authorization for hosted runners |
| `nself ci providers show` | v1.5 | read | Show one provider |
| `nself ci providers test` | v1.5 | remote | Probe a provider |
| `nself ci providers usage import` | v1.5 | write | Import provider usage records |
| `nself ci run` | v1.4 | remote | Discover .ci.yaml manifests and run their stages (pipeline) |
| `nself ci runs` | v1.5 | read | Show a run, or the flaky checks (--flaky) |
| `nself ci runs approve` | v1.5 | remote | Approve a run that waits for approval |
| `nself ci runs cancel` | v1.5 | remote | Cancel a run |
| `nself ci runs decisions` | v1.5 | read | Show the scheduling decisions of a run |
| `nself ci runs follow` | v1.5 | read | Follow the events of a run as an NDJSON stream |
| `nself ci runs list` | v1.5 | read | List recent runs |
| `nself ci runs outbox` | v1.5 | read | Show queued status and event deliveries |
| `nself ci runs pending` | v1.5 | read | List runs waiting for approval |
| `nself ci runs prune` | v1.5 | destructive | Remove old runs and logs (--dry-run previews; --tidy [--apply] also tidies cache and job roots) |
| `nself ci runs queue` | v1.5 | read | Show the run queue |
| `nself ci runs reproduce` | v1.5 | remote | Reproduce a job at its recorded inputs |
| `nself ci runs rerun` | v1.5 | remote | Run a recorded revision again on a chosen target |
| `nself ci runs resolve` | v1.5 | write | Resolve a pending run decision |
| `nself ci runs stats` | v1.5 | read | Show run statistics |
| `nself ci runs wait` | v1.5 | read | Wait for a run to finish and print its result |
| `nself ci serve` | v1.4, v1.5 | write | Start the nself-ci webhook listener daemon (port 3845) |
| `nself ci serve admin` | v1.5 | read | Coordinator admin group help |
| `nself ci serve admin audit` | v1.5 | read | Read or verify the audit log |
| `nself ci serve admin audit checkpoint` | v1.5 | write | Write a signed audit checkpoint |
| `nself ci serve admin cert` | v1.5 | write | Issue a user mTLS certificate (printed once) |
| `nself ci serve admin roles` | v1.5 | destructive | Grant, revoke or list roles |
| `nself ci serve admin token` | v1.5 | destructive | Issue, revoke or list scoped user tokens |
| `nself ci serve backup` | v1.5 | read | Back up the coordinator data directory |
| `nself ci serve install` | v1.5 | write | Install the watcher service and hourly selftest |
| `nself ci serve restore` | v1.5 | destructive | Restore the coordinator data directory from a backup |
| `nself ci serve uninstall` | v1.5 | destructive | Remove unchanged watcher service files |
| `nself ci serve watch` | v1.5 | remote | Keep commit CI current by polling, without an inbound port |

## Exit codes

| Command | Outcome | Exit |
|---|---|---:|
| ci | pass | 0 |
| ci | required check failed | 1 |
| ci | usage error | 1 |
| ci | infrastructure | 2 |
| ci | authorization | 3 |
| ci evidence verify | current bound pass | 0 |
| ci evidence verify | evidence fails | 1 |
| ci evidence verify | stale | 10 |
| ci evidence verify | invalid | 11 |
| ci evidence verify | unbound | 12 |
| ci evidence --pipeline | none overdue | 0 |
| ci evidence --pipeline | overdue | 10 |
| ci doctor | clean | 0 |
| ci doctor | check failed | 10 |
| ci doctor | warnings only | 12 |
<!-- END GENERATED:exit-codes -->

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:error-codes -->
## Error codes

Errors print as `E<number>: <message>`. The class says who fixes it: `usage` and `code` are yours, `infra` is the machine or the network.

| Code | Class | Summary | Fix | Package |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| E600 | infra | nself CLI is too old | Run nself update | `internal/model` |
| E601 | usage | document is invalid against its schema | Fix the document and retry | `internal/model` |
| E602 | usage | unsupported contract version | Use a supported contract version | `internal/model` |
| E603 | infra | V15 engine not built yet | Install a newer nself-ci plugin | `internal/model` |
| E604 | usage | illegal state transition | Use a legal state transition | `internal/store` |
| E605 | infra | state changed concurrently | Refresh attempt state and retry | `internal/store` |
| E606 | infra | database needs a newer reader | Upgrade nself-ci before opening this database | `internal/store` |
| E607 | infra | store operation failed | Check local disk and retry | `internal/store` |
| E608 | usage | idempotency key already used | Use the original attempt or a new key | `internal/store` |
| E609 | usage | operator action required | Record an operator decision before proceeding | `internal/store` |
| E610 | infra | local process execution unavailable | Use a supported local host | `internal/exec` |
| E611 | infra | requested isolation unavailable | Choose process or baseline container isolation | `internal/exec` |
| E612 | infra | job preparation failed | Check workspace and secret source | `internal/exec` |
| E613 | infra | local container execution failed | Check Docker and the selected image | `internal/exec` |
| E614 | infra | required check tool is unavailable | Install the named tool and retry | `internal/gates` |
| E615 | code | check configuration or threshold is invalid | Correct the check configuration and retry | `internal/gates` |
| E616 | usage | job dependencies form a cycle or name a job that does not exist | Remove the cycle or define the missing job in .nself/ci.yaml | `internal/plan` |
| E617 | usage | a required job depends on an allow_failure job | Make the dependency required or the dependant optional | `internal/plan` |
| E618 | infra | no runner can run this job | Install the missing tool or Docker, register a runner, or relax the job requirements | `internal/plan` |
| E619 | usage | unknown pipeline, job or fail-fast scope | Use a name defined under pipelines or jobs in .nself/ci.yaml | `internal/plan` |
| E620 | usage | .nself/ci.yaml is invalid or risky | Fix the named key at the reported file:line and retry | `internal/config` |
| E621 | usage | a legacy .ci.yaml is present under V15 | Run nself ci config migrate --write, then delete the old file | `internal/config` |
| E622 | usage | a legacy .ci.yaml field cannot become a job | Remove or hand-convert the named field | `internal/config` |
| E623 | usage | .nself/ci.yaml is git-ignored | Add .nself/* and !.nself/ci.yaml to .gitignore | `internal/config` |
| E624 | usage | --sha is not supported in V15 | Run `nself ci evidence verify <rev>` to check a revision | `internal/run` |
| E625 | usage | --trust needs a registered trust classifier | Run without --trust, or install the trust component | `internal/run` |
| E626 | usage | unknown or unusable run | List runs with `nself ci runs` and use a run id from the list | `internal/run` |
| E627 | usage | run option not available | Check `nself ci --help` for the options this build supports | `internal/run` |
| E628 | usage | evidence revision must be a full commit sha | Pass the 40 or 64 hex digits of the commit, for example $(git rev-parse HEAD) | `internal/evidence` |
| E629 | usage | evidence document rejected | Run `nself ci evidence verify <rev>` on a clean checkout to produce fresh evidence | `internal/evidence` |
| E630 | infra | evidence worktree or git facts unavailable | Check that git works in the repository and that the temporary directory is writable | `internal/evidence` |
| E631 | usage | no evidence for that run or revision | List runs with `nself ci runs`, or run `nself ci evidence verify <rev>` | `internal/evidence` |
| E632 | infra | stored job log unusable | Check that the CI state directory is writable and not full; `nself ci runs prune` frees space | `internal/logs` |
| E633 | usage | no stored logs for that job or attempt | List runs with `nself ci runs list`; logs are kept per attempt until retention removes them | `internal/logs` |
| E634 | usage | recorded platform differs from this host | Reproduce the job on a host of the recorded platform, or read the stored evidence with `nself ci evidence <run>` | `internal/reproduce` |
| E635 | usage | the original run was not bound to its commit; only the recorded revision is reproduced | Commit the changes and run the job again to get bound evidence | `internal/reproduce` |
| E636 | infra | service provisioning or teardown failed | Re-run the job; list leftovers with `docker compose ls --all` and remove any nselfci- project | `internal/services` |
| E637 | infra | Docker is required for service dependencies | Start Docker (or Colima) and re-run, or run a job that declares no services | `internal/services` |
| E638 | infra | the nself CLI does not offer the service commands | Run `nself update` | `internal/services` |
| E639 | usage | unknown service or component | List the valid names with `nself config services list --json` | `internal/services` |
| E640 | usage | a drill is invalid | Make the drill print one valid ci.evidence/v1 document on stdout (or none), and keep drills_dir entries to plain directories with an executable `run` | `internal/drill` |
| E641 | usage | a drill job is overdue | Run the scheduled pipeline (`nself-ci --pipeline <name>`) and check why the schedule stopped | `internal/drill` |
| E642 | usage | a pre-push hook already exists | Call the printed `nself ci evidence verify` line from your existing pre-push hook; nothing was overwritten | `internal/protect` |
| E643 | usage | branch protection is not available for this repository | Use the pre-push hook (`nself ci policy protect --hook`) and the auditor (`--audit <days>`) instead | `internal/protect` |
| E644 | code | truth rule file is invalid or unreadable | Correct the key named in the message in the rule file and retry | `internal/gates/truth` |
| E645 | usage | the pinned toolchain image is not available | Pass --image <ref@digest> (set NSELF_CI_IMAGE=<ref@digest> until the flag exists), or run without --container; the first publish of the pinned image is a separate owner-named action | `internal/toolchain` |
| E646 | infra | no isolation is available for the ad-hoc job | Start Docker (or Podman) to run the job in a container, or pass --isolation process to run it on this host with host networking | `internal/adhoc` |
| E647 | infra | the trust class needs an isolation level this host cannot provide | Run the job on a host with the sandboxed-container level (gVisor), or drop --trust untrusted if the command is your own | `internal/adhoc` |
| E648 | infra | detached run did not start (reason spawn, no_queued_event or child_exit) | Run the same command without --detach to see the error, then retry | `internal/detach` |
| E650 | usage | node not found | List nodes and use a registered id | `internal/nodes/registry` |
| E651 | usage | invalid node document or version | Refresh the capability and retry | `internal/nodes/registry` |
| E652 | usage | runner protocol version incompatible | Upgrade the agent to min_agent_version | `internal/protocol` |
| E653 | infra | runner protocol message invalid | Check the carrier and agent protocol stream | `internal/protocol` |
| E654 | infra | node slots full | Wait for a running job to finish or raise the agent's slot count | `internal/agent/slots` |
| E655 | usage | node host key unknown or changed | Verify the node, then run `nself ci nodes rotate <node> --host-key SHA256:<fingerprint>` (or `nself ci nodes add` for a new node) | `internal/transport/ssh` |
| E656 | infra | ssh transport failure | Check that the node is reachable and the agent is installed (`nself ci nodes test <node>`); the attempt is retried if it is retryable | `internal/transport/ssh` |
| E657 | usage | node revoked or not authorized for the project | Run nself ci nodes show <node>; add the node again or ask an admin to recover it | `internal/nodes/lifecycle` |
| E658 | usage | invalid node label | Use lowercase keys, plain short values, at most 32 labels and no nself. prefix | `internal/nodes/labels` |
| E659 | usage | pairing code invalid | Start a new pairing window with `nself ci nodes pair` and use the code it prints | `internal/pairing` |
| E660 | usage | certificate invalid | Re-pair the node (`nself ci nodes pair`), check the clock, or issue a new certificate | `internal/pki` |
| E661 | usage | job token rejected | The agent must present the token of its own lease from the session and certificate that first used it; restart the job if the token expired or the attempt ended | `internal/transport/agent` |
| E662 | infra | stale lease epoch | Stop the job and clean its workspace before retrying | `internal/lease` |
| E663 | usage | host is a deploy host and is CI-ineligible | Run CI on another machine; only an admin may pass --allow-deploy-host after confirming | `internal/nodes/deployguard` |
| E664 | usage | coordinator user API refused the request or could not be used (reason key names why: node_kind, no_credential, token_*, role, project, server_identity, transport, ...) | Use a user certificate or a scoped token that holds the needed role for the project (`nself ci serve admin roles list`), and pin the coordinator root (ci.coordinator_ca) | `internal/coordinator/clientapi` |
| E665 | auth | agent artifact verification failed (reason keys no_trusted_key, missing_signature, unknown_key, wrong_purpose, revoked, bad_signature, version_mismatch, target_mismatch, checksum_mismatch, provenance) | Install the agent from a signed release of the pinned version, or pass --agent-binary <path> with a binary you trust | `internal/agent/verify` |
| E666 | usage | agent upgrade refused (protocol ceiling, downgrade or running job) | Run nself ci nodes show <node>; wait for the job, pass --allow-downgrade, or upgrade the coordinator first | `internal/agent/update` |
| E667 | usage | LAN discovery is disabled | Unset NSELF_CI_DISCOVERY=0 and remove `ci.discovery: off` from the user config.yaml to use discovery, or pair by address with `nself ci nodes pair` | `internal/discovery` |
| E668 | infra | coordinator backup or restore refused | Check the reason: pass the KEK of the coordinator that made the backup (--kek), stop the coordinator before `serve restore`, or take a new backup | `internal/coordinator/backup` |
| E669 | infra | node bootstrap or pinned runner download failed | Read the reason key in the message: no_root needs root or passwordless sudo for the ssh user; checksum means the downloaded runner does not match its pin | `internal/nodes/bootstrap` |
| E670 | usage | policy scope loosens a parent | Tighten the lower scope or edit the operator policy | `internal/trust` |
| E671 | usage | revision or branch policy field ignored | Move spend authorization to operator policy or tighten the revision | `internal/trust` |
| E672 | usage | invalid policy key or value | Use a registered key with a valid value | `internal/trust` |
| E673 | usage | value below the redaction minimum length | Register values of at least 6 bytes; shorter values cannot be masked | `internal/redact` |
| E674 | usage | invalid secret reference or environment-name collision | Write refs as project/NAME, team/NAME, release/NAME, environment/<env>/NAME or deploy/<env>/NAME, and give each NAME once | `internal/secrets` |
| E675 | infra | secret resolver unavailable | Install an nself CLI that has `nself config secrets resolve`, or remove the secrets from the job | `internal/secrets` |
| E676 | infra | secret resolution failed | Check that the ref exists in the store file and that this node's age identity was granted the file; the attempt did not start | `internal/secrets` |
| E677 | usage | secret class or node not eligible | Run the job on a node and trust class the policy allows for this secret class, or grant the node (nself ci nodes secrets grant) if it is eligible | `internal/secrets` |
| E678 | infra | requested isolation level unavailable on this runner | Install or enable the runtime for the level, or run the job on a runner that has it | `internal/isolation` |
| E679 | infra | network scope cannot be enforced by this isolation profile | Use the none or lan scope, or install the network scope profile | `internal/isolation` |
| E680 | usage | value above the redaction maximum length | Register values of at most 128 KiB; a longer value cannot be found reliably in a scanned stream | `internal/redact` |
| E681 | infra | workspace leak detected or cleanup incomplete; node drained | Run `nself ci doctor`, remove the reported leftovers, then undrain the node | `internal/hygiene` |
| E682 | infra | no job UID is provisioned for this separation | Re-run `nself ci nodes add --system`, or enable unprivileged user namespaces for the agent user | `internal/hygiene` |
| E683 | usage | artifact path rejected | Pack only regular files, directories and in-tree relative symlinks, or choose an empty destination outside .git | `internal/authz` |
| E684 | usage | cache write denied | A cache is written only by a passing attempt in finalizing, into its own namespace, with the current epoch | `internal/authz` |
| E685 | usage | evidence rejected | Run the gate again on the exact revision with a clean worktree, or fix the reason named in the error | `internal/attest` |
| E686 | usage | evidence signature invalid, key unknown or signature replayed | Run the job again on a registered node whose evidence key is not revoked, or fix the reason named in the error | `internal/attest` |
| E687 | usage | not authorized | Use an identity that holds the needed role (`nself ci serve admin roles list`), or ask an admin to grant it | `internal/roles` |
| E688 | usage | run approval missing, void or refused | Ask a release or admin user other than the author to run `nself ci runs approve <run>` for the current head | `internal/trust/source` |
| E689 | usage | placement refused at the production boundary | Run the job on a node that is not a deploy host, or on a deploy host the operator overrode with owner or internal work, isolation vm or stronger and no release or deploy secrets; a coordinator host needs vm for team mode and for collaborator or untrusted work | `internal/trust` |
| E690 | usage | matrix entry is outside pipeline support | Declare the platform in support or remove the matrix entry | `internal/sched` |
| E691 | usage | scheduling policy value is invalid | Use a registered sched key with a valid value: a positive whole number, a duration such as 10m, or a listed name | `internal/schedpolicy` |
| E692 | usage | explain target not found or no decision record | Name a job of the current plan, or run `nself ci runs decisions` to list recorded placement decisions | `internal/planview` |
| E693 | usage | job waited past max_queue | Raise --max-queue or free capacity, then run again | `internal/dispatch` |
| E694 | usage | the project's job queue is full | Wait for queued jobs to finish (the error carries the expected wait), cancel runs you no longer need, or raise sched.queue.max_depth | `internal/fairq` |
| E695 | usage | spend refused: no budget, paid placement disabled, or approval required | Set economics.paid_enabled and a day or month budget, raise the budget, or approve the spend with `nself ci runs approve <run> --spend` | `internal/economics` |
| E696 | usage | burst provisioning refused or failed: cap, breaker, budget or provider error | Read the reason in `nself ci explain`; raise burst.max_concurrent, wait for the breaker to close, or fix the provider | `internal/burst` |
| E697 | internal | burst teardown failed; it is alerted once and retried at every sweep until the resource is gone | Check the provider API and credentials; the sweeper keeps retrying and new provisioning on that provider stays blocked until the resource is gone | `internal/burst` |
| E698 | infra | the ephemeral provider is unavailable: missing tool, adapter, token file or agent artifact | Install a container runtime (Linux) or Tart (Apple silicon), or read the reason in `nself ci doctor`; no slot is offered below container isolation | `internal/providers/ephemeral/local` |
| E699 | infra | world snapshot unavailable | Check the store and contributor registrations | `internal/world` |
| E700 | config | provider not configured or credential missing | Configure the provider and credential | `internal/providers` |
| E701 | auth | credential lacks scope or permission | Grant the named permission | `internal/providers` |
| E702 | config | provider rejected a misconfigured request | Correct the repository, workflow, ref or project | `internal/providers` |
| E703 | quota | provider rate limited or quota exhausted | Retry after the indicated time | `internal/providers` |
| E704 | transient | provider unavailable | Retry after recovery | `internal/providers` |
| E705 | config | hosted evidence rejected | Inspect evidence binding | `internal/providers` |
| E706 | auth | trigger rejected | Check signature, token, timestamp and source | `internal/providers` |
| E707 | config | runner registration or teardown failed | Inspect runner registration | `internal/providers` |
| E708 | config | job cannot be dispatched to provider | Reduce or change the job request | `internal/providers` |
| E709 | config | usage import unavailable | Check billing access and endpoint | `internal/providers` |
| E710 | infra | blob integrity failure | Discard the corrupt blob and retry transfer | `internal/blob/cas` |
| E711 | usage | cache write refused | A cache entry is saved only by a passing attempt in finalizing, with the current epoch, into its own namespace and a planned key | `internal/cache/entries` |
| E712 | infra | artifact commit refused | Declare outputs that exist inside the job workdir, stay under the size caps and the disk floor and hold no registered secret; `nself ci artifacts prune` frees space | `internal/artifacts/records` |
| E713 | usage | artifact not found | Check the id with `nself ci artifacts list`; an artifact you may not see reads as not found | `internal/artifacts/records` |
| E714 | infra | blob transfer failed | A remote attempt could not hand its artifact to the coordinator (stale lease, digest mismatch, interruption, protocol fault or size cap); run the job again, and raise NSELF_CI_ARTIFACT_MAX_FILE or free store space for a size_cap | `internal/blob/transfer` |
| E715 | usage | release job not admitted | Run the release job's dependencies again on a clean, committed tree, then retry the release | `internal/release/job` |
| E716 | usage | operator resolution refused | Use the attempt id from `nself ci runs <run>` and the NSELF_CI_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY the release job received (its publish step logs it), then run `nself ci runs resolve` again | `internal/release/job` |
| E717 | infra | release signing failed | Run `nself ci artifacts key init` once to create the release key, make sure every attempt of the run is finished, and release only digests that are committed records of the run | `internal/signing` |
| E718 | infra | SBOM failed | Run `nself ci artifacts tools install` to place the pinned syft, then retry; an invalid SBOM means syft's output failed the structural check, so rerun with the pinned version | `internal/sbom` |
| E719 | usage | release verification failed | Read the reason key in the output; fetch the release again, or run `nself ci artifacts verify <dir> --json` for every check | `internal/release/verify` |
| E793 | usage | runner inventory refused | Give a file or a command that prints one inventory/v1 document under 1 MiB within 10 seconds; run sync on the machine that owns the nodes, not on a TEAM coordinator | `internal/nodes/inventory` |
| E797 | usage | --where value is unknown or not available | Use local, a node id, a pool id, hosted, auto or all (all needs a race hook); list targets with `nself ci nodes pools list` | `internal/where` |
| E799 | infra | another watcher holds this host's run lock | Wait for the other watcher or stop it, then retry | `internal/readiness` |
| E800 | infra | readiness.cmd gave no usable answer | Make the hook exit 0 (ready) or 3 (not ready, reason on its first output line) within 5 seconds; it runs with PATH and LANG only, so use absolute paths | `internal/readiness` |
| E804 | usage | a watch.* setting is invalid | Fix the operator value (`nself ci policy show` names the key) and restart the watcher | `internal/watch` |
| E805 | quota | the GitHub quota stopped the watch pass | Nothing to do: the watcher makes no request before the recorded reset time; raise providers.github.poll_interval if it recurs | `internal/watch` |
| E807 | usage | a tracked file is secret-shaped or over the size cap | Untrack the file, or run the gate on a clean checkout | `internal/offload` |
| E809 | policy | not_a_record_pool | Run commit CI on a pool listed in pools.record | `internal/pools/record` |
| E812 | code | a .gitleaksignore entry has no review comment | Put `# Reviewed YYYY-MM-DD [by <who>]: <reason>` on the line before each entry, or add entries with `nself ci config ignore add <fingerprint> --reason <text>` | `internal/gates` |
| E813 | infra | a notification sink did not take the message | Delivery counts are kept per sink (`nself ci doctor --selftest` shows them, P7-AUTO-20); a webhook needs https and a public address (notify.allow_private for a LAN one); a command sink must exit 0 within 10 seconds | `internal/notify` |
| E816 | infra | the GitHub App check run was not published (the status was) | The commit status is the result of record and was posted; only the optional `nself-ci/gates` check run failed. Check providers.github.app.id, providers.github.app.installation_id and the PEM in the variable named by providers.github.app.key_env, and that the App has checks:write on the repository. Set the key variable only in the environment of the v1.5 runner service, never in a shell profile or a job | `internal/providers/github/checks` |
| E819 | usage | per-run policy value ignored | A per-run flag can only tighten the policy (the preset is a preference); change the project or operator policy instead | `internal/trust` |
| E821 | policy | skipped: needs isolated runner | A collaborator head runs only on an isolated runner; add one (the isolation section of `nself ci doctor` shows what this machine proved) or let the coordinator run it | `internal/watch` |
